_note: Restaurants a boater can reach by water. A place is listed only when its own site or the visitors bureau says customers can arrive by boat.
intro: Places that say you can come by boat. Neither says whether docking is free or how many boats fit, so call ahead.

items.note: 141 Route 507, Hawley. 570-226-5027. Its own site welcomes guests arriving by car or by boat.
At Silver Birches, 205 Route 507, Hawley. 570-226-4388. The visitors bureau lists it as reachable by boat or car; the resort's own pages do not mention docking for diners.

fine: Other lakefront restaurants may welcome boats, but we found no statement from them. Docks come out of the water for winter. Owners: use 'Claim or correct' on your pin to be added.
